strands.outcomes: By the end of the sub strand, the learners should be able to: a) explain the performance of the skills of sprint starts and sprinting techniques, b) perform the skill of medium and elongated sprint starts and sprinting techniques for knowledge and skill development, c) sing the Kenya National Anthem applying performance techniques,
